name: Cantor Equity Partners V Inc. Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Cantor Equity Partners V, Inc.'s primary mission involves executing a strategic business combination—such as a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, or reorganization—with entities operating across the financial services, healthcare, real estate services, technology, and software sectors. Founded in 2021, the firm maintains its headquarters in New York, New York. It was previously designated as CF International Acquisition Corp. VII.
